content:
**q07.** `web/src/connect.ts`

All ConnectRPC service clients are created there via `createClient(...)` over a shared `createConnectTransport` instance (`web/src/connect.ts:184`), and exported as module-level singletons — `instanceServiceClient`, `authServiceClient`, `userServiceClient`, `memoServiceClient`, `attachmentServiceClient`, `aiServiceClient`, `shortcutServiceClient`, `identityProviderServiceClient` (`web/src/connect.ts:192`–`203`). The file also holds a separate `refreshTransport`/`refreshAuthClient` pair (`web/src/connect.ts:65`, `:72`) used by the token-refresh interceptor so refresh calls bypass the main interceptor chain.
